    The ray-category front end of a split-basic algebra #

    Attach the BGRS unit-ray construction to the concrete category of chosen primitive projectives. For a finite-dimensional split-basic algebra, the single distributive-Hom package supplies the special product laws, finite ray Hom sets, span factorization, cancellation, and hence every finite-ray-category axiom. Deriving that package from representation-finiteness remains the concrete algebraic bridge.
